# 2 Chronicles Chapter 27 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

## Consensus Translation

**1** Jotham was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. His mother's name was Jerusha the daughter of Zadok.

**2** And he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD according to all that his father Uzziah had done — except he did not enter the temple of the LORD. But the people still followed corrupt practices.

**3** He built the upper gate of the house of the LORD and did much building on the wall of Ophel.

**4** Moreover, he built cities in the hill country of Judah, and fortresses and towers in the wooded areas.

**5** He fought with the king of the Ammonites and prevailed against them. The Ammonites gave him that year 100 talents of silver, 10,000 cors of wheat, and 10,000 cors of barley. The Ammonites paid him the same amount in the second and the third years.

**6** So Jotham became mighty, because he ordered his ways before the LORD his God.

**7** Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all his wars and his ways, behold, they are written in the Book of the Kings of Israel and Judah.

**8** He was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem.

**9** And Jotham slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David. And Ahaz his son reigned in his place.

---
## SOPHIA's Council Notes

No significant council discussion for this chapter.

---
## Disagreement Log

- **PNEUMA:** "He did what was right in the LORD's eyes, just as his father Uzziah had done — though unlike his father, he did not ente"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.

### V.3
- **EMET:** "He built gate-of house-of YHWH the-upper and-on wall-of the-Ophel he-built much."
- **LOGOS:** "He built the upper gate of the house of the LORD and did much building on the wall of Ophel."
- **PNEUMA:** "He rebuilt the Upper Gate of the LORD's temple and did extensive work on the wall at the hill of Ophel."
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.

### V.5

- **PNEUMA:** "He fought and defeated the king of the Ammonites. That year the Ammonites paid him 100 talents of silver, 10,000 cors of"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.

### V.6
- **EMET:** "And-he-became-mighty Jotham for he-established his-ways before YHWH his-God."
- **LOGOS:** "So Jotham became mighty, because he ordered his ways before the LORD his God."
- **PNEUMA:** "Jotham grew powerful because he walked steadfastly before the LORD his God."
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.

### V.7
- **EMET:** "And-rest-of acts-of Jotham and-all his-wars and-his-ways behold-them written on book-of kings-of Israel and-Judah."
- **LOGOS:** "Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all his wars and his ways, behold, they are written in the Book of the Kings of "
- **PNEUMA:** "The other events of Jotham's reign, including all his wars and everything else he did, are recorded in the Book of the K"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.

### V.9
- **EMET:** "And-he-lay-down Jotham with his-fathers and-they-buried-him in-city-of David and-he-reigned Ahaz his-son in-his-place."
- **LOGOS:** "And Jotham slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David. And Ahaz his son reigned in his place."
- **PNEUMA:** "Jotham rested with his ancestors and was buried in the City of David. His son Ahaz succeeded him as king."
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.

---
*— SOPHIA, in council with EMET, LOGOS, and PNEUMA*
